description: This file defines the main React component for a Sudoku game with retro styling, including utility functions, state management, and UI components for the game grid, number pad, and controls.

methods.name: cloneGrid
methods.description: Deep copies a 2D array representing the Sudoku grid.

methods.name: findConflicts
methods.description: Identifies conflicting cells in the Sudoku grid based on Sudoku rules.

methods.name: isComplete
methods.description: Checks if the Sudoku grid is fully filled with valid numbers.

methods.name: validateGrid
methods.description: Validates the current grid, returning conflicts and whether the puzzle is solved.
